name: Nightingale
description: Nightingale is an open-source monitoring and alerting platform. Like Grafana it connects to existing data sources such as Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Elasticsearch, Loki, ClickHouse or MySQL, but its focus is the alerting engine: alert rules, muting, subscriptions, event pipelines and notifications to more than 20 channels, plus dashboards, a host inventory fed by the Categraf agent and a built-in time series database. This script installs the prebuilt release with MariaDB and Redis.

notes.text: Log in at http://<IP>:17000 as root with password root.2020. These defaults are public and the account is an administrator, so change the password right after the install: the user menu in the top right, Profile, Change password.

No external Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics is needed: metrics pushed by Categraf agents land in Nightingale's built-in time series database, registered as the datasource embedded-tsdb. Install Categraf on the hosts to monitor from Infrastructure, Hosts, which serves the bundled agent and generates the install command. Samples are kept 15 days and capped at 4 GiB, set in [EmbeddedTSDB] of /opt/nightingale_data/config.toml.

Unlike the upstream default, anonymous queries against the datasources are disabled (PromQuerier = false in [Center.AnonymousAccess] of /opt/nightingale_data/config.toml), because they would let anyone who reaches port 17000 read every datasource. Set it to true for dashboards shared without login, then run systemctl restart nightingale.
